name: Ring of Elemental Command (Air)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Dominate an Air Elemental
powers.text: 2 charges: cast Dominate Monster (save DC 18) on an Air Elemental.

summary: Command over Air elementals, Resistance to Lightning damage, and its element's spells (save DC 18).
text: This ring is linked to the Elemental Plane of Air. While wearing it, you have Advantage on attack rolls against Air Elementals, and they have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. The ring has 5 charges and regains 1d4 + 1 expended charges daily at dawn. You can expend 2 of them to cast Dominate Monster (save DC 18) on an Air Elemental. You also have Resistance to Lightning damage. You can fly at 60 feet and you know Auran; Feather Fall at will. You can cast its spells from it, spending the charges listed: Feather Fall (0), Gust Of Wind (2), Wind Wall (1), Chain Lightning (3).
